taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-19, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for station T-19, we analyze the resistivity values of the four layers:
- Layer 1 (r1): 609.2 ohm-m
- Layer 2 (r2): 7309.9 ohm-m
- Layer 3 (r3): 4367.7 ohm-m
- Layer 4 (r4): 4556.7 ohm-m

A curve with 4 layers results in 4 - 2 = 2 letters.

1.  **First group (Layers 1-2-3):**
    Compare r1, r2, and r3:
    609.2 < 7309.9 and 7309.9 > 4367.7
    This matches the pattern r1 < r2 > r3, which corresponds to the letter **K**.

2.  **Second group (Layers 2-3-4):**
    Compare r2, r3, and r4:
    7309.9 > 4367.7 and 4367.7 < 4556.7
    This matches the pattern r1 > r2 < r3 (applied to the current group: r2 > r3 < r4), which corresponds to the letter **H**.

The resulting curve type is KH.

{"curve_type": "KH"}
